content.text: [Feishu Group #compliance stefan.vogel Thu Mar 20 10:00 CET 2026] IMPORTANT UPDATE: HR Analytics module — new 'Health Status Prediction' feature is now included in the beta scope. This feature processes employee health indicators (sick leave patterns, productivity metrics correlated with health risk scores). This is special category data under Art. 9 GDPR. The DPIA for HR Analytics must be updated to reflect this addition. Workspace file `company/hr_analytics_new_feature.md` contains full technical specification. DPO and consultant: please review and update the DPIA risk matrix accordingly.

Update received. HR Analytics now includes Health Status Prediction using Art. 9 special category data (health). This significantly changes the DPIA assessment: the module now meets Art. 35(3)(b) (large-scale processing of Art. 9 data), making DPIA mandatory regardless of the 9-criteria count. SA consultation may be required. I will update the DPIA risk matrix in Q9.
